title: Recommendation Provenance System — Full Audit & Design

currentRecommendationFunctions.notes: Provenance recorded in _appendNextBestStep wrapper via May._recordRecommendation → MayLearnerState.recordRecommendationDelivery. The generate function returns a structured object but provenance is bolted on at display time.

missingProvenanceFields: TriggeringRule (which condition triggered the focus area)
currentRecommendationFunctions.notes: One _recordRecommendation call per suggestion (up to 3). Evidence object is passed but is minimal — accuracy/attempts/pattern fields only, not the full observation.
Only weakTopics are recorded — strongTopics and pattern-based recommendations are NOT recorded. Evidence passed is empty {}. Section is null.
Only weakTopics are recorded. The digest's strongest-topics, misconceptions, learning-momentum, and weekly-focus sections are not provenance-tracked. Evidence is empty {}.

CRITICAL GAP: _generateSessionRecap returns a recommended next step (lines 3041-3048) that is displayed to the learner but NEVER recorded via _recordRecommendation. The recap is generated inside _summarizeSession (line 3664) and spoken directly.
CRITICAL GAP: Called in _buildWelcomeOverview (line 307) when a returning student is selected. Returns a string. Never recorded. This is the first recommendation a returning learner sees.
CRITICAL GAP: Pre-exam briefing includes topic review suggestions based on weakness clusters (lines 879-888). These review-topic recommendations are spoken directly with no provenance recording.

SourceEvidence (no accuracy/trend evidence stored with recommendation)

missingProvenanceFields: ALL outcome/provenance fields from recommendationOutcomes system

system1_recommendationOutcomes.description: Coaching-path recommendations (next_best_step, focus_area, weekly_digest, study_strategy). Stored via recordRecommendationDelivery().

sourceSessionId.description: Active session when recommendation was generated

evidenceAtDelivery.description: Minimal evidence snapshot — varies by recommendation type

missingProvenanceFields: SourceEvidence: evidenceAtDelivery is minimal and inconsistent across types. For next_best_step it has accuracy/attempts/isCorrect/errorCategory. For focus_area it has evidence from the suggestion. For weekly_digest/study_strategy it is empty {}.
SourceSessions: Only sourceSessionId (single session). No array of all contributing sessions. No way to trace which practice sessions informed this recommendation.
TriggeringRule: No field recording which function + which condition + which threshold generated this. E.g., 'suggestFocusAreas → persistent_weakness → accuracy < 60% && attempts >= 5'.
ObservationChain: No chain from raw data → observations → recommendation. The _identifyLearningPatterns observations that fed into the recommendation are not stored.
TopicScope: Only single topic. _suggestFocusAreas can recommend adjacent weak topics, but only the primary topic is stored.
provenanceStore: No dedicated provenance container. Fields are scattered across the recommendation entry.

system2_recommendationLog.description: QID-level recommendation events (recommendSimilar, recommendNext, recovery set). Stored via logRecommendation().
missingProvenanceFields: ProvenanceID: No unique identifier — entries are anonymous array items
SourceEvidence: No accuracy/trend data stored. The weakness clusters used to drive _recommendNext are not recorded.
ObservationChain: No trace from weakness clusters → recommendation
OutcomeHistory: recommendationLog has NO outcome tracking. No way to know if the learner followed the QID recommendation or whether it helped.
TopicScope: Single sourceTopic string, no multi-topic support
Cross-reference to recommendationOutcomes: No bridge between the two systems

unifiedGaps: Two separate storage systems with no cross-referencing: recommendationOutcomes (coaching) and recommendationLog (QID-level)
No single view of all recommendations across both systems
No outcome tracking for QID-level recommendations
No QID-level detail for coaching recommendations
Evidence fidelity varies dramatically: empty {} for weekly_digest/study_strategy vs. rich evidence for next_best_step

provenanceDesign.designNotes: The provenance record below is designed to be a unified superset. Every recommendation — regardless of type — would use this single schema. Existing fields from both systems are mapped into it. New fields fill the gaps.

fields.name: ProvenanceID
fields.description: Universally unique identifier: 'prov-' + timestamp(36) + '-' + hash(topic+type+session). Replaces recommendationId (recommendationOutcomes) and adds IDs to recommendationLog entries which currently have none.
fields.source: NEW — unifies recommendationId from Outcomes; adds to Log

fields.name: RecommendationType
fields.description: next_best_step | focus_area | study_strategy | weekly_digest | session_recap | pre_exam_briefing | similar_question | qid_recommendation | recovery_set | next_action
fields.source: EXTENDED — adds session_recap, pre_exam_briefing, next_action, qid_recommendation, similar_question, recovery_set

fields.name: RecommendationSubType
fields.description: Granular classification: targeted_practice, formula_review, concept_review, high/medium/low (for focus_area), weekly_focus, priority_topic, persistent_weak, declining_or_unstable, similar_question, recovery_set

fields.name: RecommendationTimestamp
fields.description: When the recommendation was generated and delivered to the learner

fields.name: RecommendationText
fields.description: Full text of the recommendation as shown to the learner (not truncated to 500 chars)

fields.name: SourceEvidence
fields.description: Complete evidence objects that triggered this recommendation. Each object has: { category, description, data (accuracy, attempts, trends, patterns, clusters), sourceSessionIds }.
fields.source: NEW — supersedes the inconsistent evidenceAtDelivery field. Aggregates evidence from: topicProgress, trend data, misconception patterns, weakness clusters, difficulty distributions, hint usage trends, confidence calibration.

fields.name: SourceSessions
fields.description: All session IDs whose data contributed evidence to this recommendation. Currently only sourceSessionId (single session) is stored.
fields.source: NEW — extends sourceSessionId/activeSessionId to an array

fields.name: TriggeringRule
fields.description: Which function, which condition, and which threshold generated this recommendation. E.g., { function: '_suggestFocusAreas', condition: 'persistent_weakness', threshold: 'accuracy < 60% && attempts >= 5', decisiveFactors: ['accuracy=42%', 'attempts=7'] }
fields.source: NEW — no equivalent in either existing system

fields.name: ObservationChain
fields.description: Ordered chain from raw observations → recommendation. Each link: { observationId, category, evidence, recommendationID }. Captures the full reasoning path: e.g., topicProgress[topic].accuracy=42 → persistent_weakness observation → focus_area recommendation.
fields.source: NEW — _identifyLearningPatterns results are not currently stored

fields.name: TopicScope
fields.description: All topics this recommendation covers, with per-topic evidence. Each: { topic, section, accuracy, attempts, priority, reason }. Currently only single topic is stored.
fields.source: EXTENDED — replaces single topic/section with multi-topic array

fields.name: RecommendedQids
fields.description: QIDs recommended (for QID-level recommendations). Null for coaching/text recommendations.
fields.source: EXISTING — from recommendationLog, added to coaching recommendations when applicable

fields.name: GateCompliance
fields.description: Audit trail of gate checks: { defectManifestBlocked: string[], contestedExcluded: string[], nonCertifiedQids: string[], packPool: string[], gateCheckedAt: ISO8601 }
fields.source: EXTENDED — unifies excludedByDefect/Contested from Log, adds gate timestamp

fields.name: OutcomeHistory
fields.description: What happened after delivery. Each entry: { timestamp, event (delivered|acted_on|ignored|superseded|classified), outcome (positive|neutral|insufficient|contradictory|null), evidence (accuracy delta, trend direction, attempt count), classifiedAt }
fields.source: EXTENDED — enriches existing status/outcome/outcomeEvidence fields with a timeline

fields.name: LearnerFollowed
fields.description: Whether the learner took action consistent with the recommendation. null = unknown. Determined by: did they start a session on the recommended topic? Did they review the recommended QID?
fields.source: NEW — no equivalent in either system. Requires session-intent matching.

fields.name: FollowUpEvidence
fields.description: Evidence gathered after the recommendation: { sessionsCompleted: N, topicAccuracyAfter: N, trendAfter: string, attemptsAfter: N }. Populated asynchronously when new session data arrives.
fields.source: NEW — extends outcomeEvidence with structured before/after comparison

fields.name: ProvenanceModelVersion
fields.description: Model version of the provenance system itself. E.g., 'S130-1.0'. Enables forward/backward compatibility of provenance records.

fields.name: ParentRecommendationId
fields.description: If this recommendation supersedes or refines an earlier one, link to its ProvenanceID. Enables recommendation lineage tracking (e.g., focus_area refined after more sessions).

unifiedStorage.migration: recommendationOutcomes and recommendationLog remain as legacy fields; provenanceRecords becomes the single source of truth for all new recommendations. A migration script can backfill provenanceRecords from existing recommendationOutcomes + recommendationLog.

partialProvenance: _recommendNext (via logRecommendation — separate system, no outcome tracking, no unified ID)
_recommendSimilar (via logRecommendation — separate system, no outcome tracking)
_generateRecoverySet (via logRecommendation — separate system, no outcome tracking)
noProvenance: _generateSessionRecap — returns recommended next step but never recorded
_recommendNextAction — first recommendation a returning learner sees, never recorded
preExamBriefing — review topic suggestions based on weakness clusters, never recorded

storageUnification.note: These two systems operate independently. recommendationLog has no outcome tracking. recommendationOutcomes has no QID-level detail. No single query can show all recommendations with outcomes.

step1.title: Unify the two storage systems into a single provenanceRecords array
step1.description: Create a new provenanceRecords field in MayLearnerState._default(). All recommendations — coaching and QID-level — write to this single array using the unified ProvenanceRecord schema.
changes: Add provenanceRecords: [] to _default() schema
Create recordProvenance(provenanceRecord) method as single entry point
Deprecate recordRecommendationDelivery() — redirect to recordProvenance()
Deprecate logRecommendation() — redirect to recordProvenance()

step2.title: Add ProvenanceID generation to all recommendation-generating functions
step2.description: Every function that produces a recommendation generates a ProvenanceID before delivering it. The ID format: 'prov-' + Date.now().toString(36) + '-' + crypto.randomUUID().slice(0,8).
changes: Add _generateProvenanceID() helper to May
Wire into _recordRecommendation (line 3538) to auto-generate IDs
Wire into logRecommendation calls in _recommendNext, _recommendSimilar, _generateRecoverySet

step3.title: Add provenance recording to the three functions with NO provenance
step3.description: _generateSessionRecap, _recommendNextAction, and preExamBriefing currently generate recommendations with zero provenance.
changes: _generateSessionRecap (line 2941): After computing the recommended next step (lines 3041-3048), call _recordRecommendation with type='session_recap' including the full topicEntries as SourceEvidence.
_recommendNextAction (line 338): Call _recordRecommendation with type='next_action' including clusters and sessionCount as SourceEvidence.
preExamBriefing (line 845): After computing review topics from weakness clusters (lines 879-888), call _recordRecommendation for each review topic with type='pre_exam_briefing'.

step4.title: Enrich evidence fidelity — populate SourceEvidence, ObservationChain, TriggeringRule
step4.description: Currently evidenceAtDelivery is minimal or empty. Each recommendation function must pass the full observation set.
changes: _generateStudyStrategy: Pass full weakTopics, strongTopics, patterns arrays as evidence (not empty {})
_generateWeeklyDigest: Pass full topicEntries, patterns, firstPct/lastPct as evidence (not empty {})
_generateNextBestStep: Already has rich evidence; add ObservationChain linking _identifyLearningPatterns results
_suggestFocusAreas: Add TriggeringRule recording which condition (persistent_weakness, calculation_miss, misconception, topic_strength, improving) triggered each suggestion
All functions: Add ObservationChain showing the data → observation → recommendation path

step5.title: Add SourceSessions tracking — record all contributing sessions
step5.description: Currently only sourceSessionId (single session) is stored. Change to an array of all sessions whose data informed the recommendation.
changes: In _recordRecommendation: Accept sourceSessions array parameter
In each recommendation function: Collect session IDs from the data used. E.g., _generateWeeklyDigest uses lookbackSessions — pass their IDs.
In recordProvenance: Store sourceSessions array
Update recordRecommendationDelivery to accept sourceSessions

step6.title: Implement LearnerFollowed detection
step6.description: After each new session completes, check if the learner acted on prior recommendations. Did they practice the recommended topic? Did they review the recommended QID?
changes: Add detectRecommendationFollowThrough() method
Call from handoffCompletedSession() after classifyPendingOutcomes()
Match: recommended topic → session topic coverage; recommended QID → session attempts
Set LearnerFollowed = true/false based on evidence

step7.title: Add provenance viewer to May UI — 'Why this recommendation?' toggle
step7.description: Parallel to the existing 'Why this snapshot?' debug toggle for readiness (line 4828). Add a provenance toggle in the chat view that shows the evidence chain behind each recommendation.
changes: Add _renderRecommendationProvenance() method
When a recommendation is displayed in chat, attach a 'Why this?' expandable section
Show: SourceEvidence summary, TriggeringRule, contributing sessions, outcome if known

step8.title: Backfill provenance from existing recommendationOutcomes + recommendationLog
step8.description: One-time migration script that reads existing recommendationOutcomes and recommendationLog entries and creates provenanceRecords entries with as much data as can be inferred.
changes: Read existing recommendationOutcomes → map to ProvenanceRecord schema
Read existing recommendationLog → map to ProvenanceRecord schema
Cross-reference by timestamp and topic where possible
Generate ProvenanceIDs for all entries
Mark backfilled entries with ProvenanceModelVersion: 'S130-backfill'

provenanceCoverageAfterImplementation.note: After full implementation, all 10 recommendation-generating functions write to the unified provenanceRecords array. The two legacy systems (recommendationOutcomes, recommendationLog) are deprecated but preserved for backward compatibility.

riskRegister.risk: Breaking existing tests that rely on recommendationOutcomes or recommendationLog schema
riskRegister.mitigation: Keep legacy fields; add provenanceRecords alongside them. Deprecate, don't delete. Update test assertions to check both old and new fields.

riskRegister.risk: Storage quota — each provenance record is larger than current entries
riskRegister.mitigation: Cap provenanceRecords at 500 entries (vs current 200). Use rolling window. Compress SourceEvidence to summary statistics for older entries.

riskRegister.risk: Inconsistent data between legacy and new provenance fields during transition
riskRegister.mitigation: recordProvenance() writes to both old and new fields during a transition period. Run reconciliation checks.

riskRegister.risk: Performance impact of ObservationChain construction on every recommendation
riskRegister.mitigation: ObservationChain is built from in-memory data already loaded for the recommendation; no additional I/O. Estimated <1ms overhead.
